business_summary: Alphamab Oncology, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and commercialization of biotherapeutics for cancer treatment in the People's Republic of China. It offers KN035, an injectable PD-L1 inhibitor for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic microsatellite instability-high/efficient mismatch repair advanced solid tumors under the ENWEIDA brand. Its product pipeline includes KN026, an anti-human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) bispecific monoclonal antibody (BsAb) that is in Phase III clinical trials to treat HER2-positive breast cancer and HER2-positive gastric cancer or gastroesophageal junction cancer; KN046, a BsAb immune checkpoint inhibitor in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), squamous NSCLC, triple-negative breast cancer, and recurrent and metastatic esophageal squamous cell carcinoma; JSKN003, a biparatopic HER2-targeting antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) that is in Phase III clinical trial to treat HER2-expressing advanced or metastatic solid tumors, HER2-low expression breast cancer, platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer, primary peritoneal cancer, and fallopian tube cancer. In addition, the company is developing JSKN016, a bispecific ADC that is in Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of solid tumors, lung cancer, and breast cancer; JSKN022, a bispecific single-domain antibody; JSKN027, a bispecific ADC that is Phase I clinical trial; JSKN021; KN019; and JSKN033, a subcutaneous ADC in Phase I clinical trial to treat HER2-expressing advanced or metastatic solid tumors. The company also develops JSKN029, a pre-clinical stage product for oncology applications. Alphamab Oncology was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Suzhou, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 바이오의약품 회사인 Alphamab Oncology는 중국에서 암 치료를 위한 바이오치료제의 연구, 개발, 제조 및 상업화에 종사하고 있습니다. ENWEIDA 브랜드는 절제 불가능하거나 전이성 미세부수체 불안정성으로 높은/효율적인 불일치 복구 진행성 고형 종양을 치료하는 주사용 PD-L1 억제제인 ​​KN035를 제공합니다. 제품 파이프라인에는 HER2 양성 유방암 및 HER2 양성 위암 또는 위식도 접합부 암 치료를 위한 3상 임상 시험이 진행 중인 항인간 표피 성장 인자 수용체 2(HER2) 이중특이적 단일클론 항체(BsAb)인 KN026이 포함됩니다. 비소세포폐암(NSCLC), 편평 NSCLC, 삼중 음성 유방암, 재발성 및 전이성 식도 편평 세포 암종 치료를 위한 3상 임상 시험의 BsAb 면역 관문 억제제 KN046; JSKN003은 HER2 발현 진행성 또는 전이성 고형종양, HER2 저발현 유방암, 백금저항성 재발성 상피성 난소암, 원발성 난소암 등을 치료하기 위한 3상 임상시험이 진행 중인 2중 파라토프 HER2 표적화 항체-약물 결합체(ADC)다.
